title: Predictions About The Future
subtitle: While I'm on vacation...
text:
I head on vacation with my kids. Thus, this post, scheduled this post for my readers and maybe a few more. A few outlandish predictions, so I can be on record in the future when anyone checks:

• Neuromodulation (especially accelerated TMS) will be a first-line treatment for depression in 5 years.

• Neuromodulation (various modalities) will be the first line for almost all psychiatric conditions in 10 years

• Antipsychotic medication augmentation in depression will be deemed dubious in 5 years and barbaric in 10

• Psychiatry, as a medical discipline, will manage obesity and other general medical problems routinely in 10 years

• Chris Palmer M.D. will be viewed as a visionary leader.

• Nolan Williams MD Wins the 2024 Nobel for SAINT/SNT.

• Interventional psychiatry fellowships will exist.

• PBMs will be unrecognizable in 3-4 years or regulated away.

• The Big Health payers will have AI Equipped short sellers who will come at them hard.

• In-person events will be all the rage again cause they can't be faked by AI (yet).

• Westworld comes back.

• Wood pulp paper makes a comeback also thanks to AI also.

• The photographic film (Kodak, Polaroid) similarly goes back into production

• No criminal cases will be built on the basis of wiretap evidence only (Every criminal defense legal council will allege deep fake allegations)

• Crypto makes a comeback and a way to micro pay for AI to reduce chaos magic by increasing the cost enough to reduce spam.

• Linguistic “tells” algorithmically embedded into LLM output to mark fake vs real.

That is what I got!
